plain_italian_summary: Gli ultimi test non richiedono modifiche immediate a Excel o deck, ma confermano che il P&L deve restare pre-ricavi finche non esistono approvazione proprietario, setup fiscale, pagamenti, fatture, privacy/legal e cost guard live. Prima del go-live vanno aggiornati prezzi e margini per alcuni prodotti.

pnl_delta_findings.delta: No real revenue can be recognized during current test phase.
pnl_delta_findings.impact: P&L must keep beta revenue as planning/simulated only.
pnl_delta_findings.action_required: Do not book revenue until real payment, invoice and legal/fiscal gates are approved.

pnl_delta_findings.delta: Score Pack 1k at 99 EUR is close to margin threshold; 119 EUR is safer before live.
pnl_delta_findings.impact: Revenue scenarios should include 99 EUR conservative and 119 EUR revised case.
pnl_delta_findings.action_required: Update P&L sensitivity before go-live, not during NoWrite test.

pnl_delta_findings.delta: Deep Analysis at 249 EUR has weak planning margin; 349 EUR or cost reduction is recommended.
pnl_delta_findings.impact: Deep Analysis should not be first live product without cost proof.
pnl_delta_findings.action_required: Model 249/349 EUR scenarios and require cost per valid report threshold.

pnl_delta_findings.delta: Target Discovery at 149 EUR is cost-heavy; 249 EUR or later launch is recommended.
pnl_delta_findings.impact: No-list acquisition path is valuable but could hurt margin if sold too early.
pnl_delta_findings.action_required: Keep as add-on or model higher price before live.

pnl_delta_findings.delta: Action Pack remains best margin candidate if Deep Analysis gate is mandatory.
pnl_delta_findings.impact: First monetization bundle can prioritize Score Pack + Action Pack, but still no live sale now.
pnl_delta_findings.action_required: Keep gate and cost cap in P&L.

pnl_delta_findings.delta: Agent credit cost must remain a variable cost per valid output, not a generic overhead.
pnl_delta_findings.impact: Gross margin must include agent cost by product line.
pnl_delta_findings.action_required: P&L should show agent credits as variable COGS before any live pricing decision.

pnl_delta_findings.delta: Prior 429/KV warnings mean write-capped tests and eventual paid volume need cost/write guardrails.
pnl_delta_findings.impact: Infrastructure cost cannot be treated as flat zero even in agent-only model.
pnl_delta_findings.action_required: Add Cloudflare/worker/KV write caps and paid-plan trigger as explicit P&L assumptions.

pnl_delta_findings.delta: Post-sale can be agent-led but still needs support/error handling cost assumptions.
pnl_delta_findings.impact: Support cost remains small but non-zero per customer or per incident.
pnl_delta_findings.action_required: Keep support cost component in COGS or operating costs.

pnl_delta_findings.delta: Legal, privacy, VAT/fiscal, invoicing and payment provider are blockers before monetization.
pnl_delta_findings.impact: Go-live timeline and one-off setup costs must remain in P&L assumptions.
pnl_delta_findings.action_required: Do not remove admin/legal/fiscal costs from the plan.

product_pnl_status.reason: Scalable entry product, but margin is close to threshold at 99 EUR.
Catalog currently lists 399 EUR while latest price revision pack discussed 149 EUR planning candidate. This mismatch should be reconciled before updating P&L externally.
Important for no-list buyers but cost-heavy and needs market availability guard.

recommended_pnl_updates_when_owner_appro: Keep revenue rows as simulated/planning until live payment and invoice gates are approved.
Add product-level COGS with data source, agent credit, infrastructure, quality control and support components.
Add explicit agent credit variable cost per valid output.
Add Cloudflare/KV/Worker guardrail line and paid-plan trigger.
Add price sensitivity for Score Pack 1k: 99 EUR and 119 EUR.
Reconcile Action Pack price mismatch between product catalog and latest price revision pack.
Mark Deep Analysis and Target Discovery as later-live or higher-price candidates.
Keep legal/fiscal/admin setup costs before monetization.
no_file_update_reason: This step is NoWrite planning. It intentionally does not update the Excel P&L or PowerPoint deck because the user did not explicitly approve editing those attached business-plan files in this heartbeat, and no live commercial state is approved.
